description.no: Landet med flest druesorter i verden, region for region — hva de dyrker, hvorfor det vokser akkurat der, og hva det smaker av.
description.en: The country with more grape varieties than any other, region by region — what they grow, why it grows there, and what it tastes of.

//factions: Not sides in a war. A pack's factions are just named colours the map and
the DOM can both reach, and for a subject with no combatants the honest
use is the thing the subject actually divides into: what is in the glass.
Four, because four is what a wine map needs to say anything: red, white,
sparkling and sweet. A region lights up in the colour of what it is known
for. `neutral` is everywhere that grows nothing worth a chapter, and it
has to exist or the rest of the country vanishes.

//basemap: The Mediterranean extract already exists -- it was built for Rome, and
Italy is the middle of it. A subject does not need its own basemap
level when a shipped one covers the ground.
//borders: Modern borders, and for once that is simply correct. CLAUDE.md's rule
is that modern boundaries are wrong for history -- Massachusetts
included Maine. Wine is grown in Italy's present regions and the
appellation map is drawn on them, so the shipped default is the honest

era.//start: 1963 is when Italy's appellation law was passed, which is the oldest date this course has any reason to put on a scrubber.

//media: allowPhoto is TRUE here, and it is the only pack where it is. The rule it
relaxes exists because a photographic plate reads as a RECORD, and for a
subject that predates photography there is no such record to be mistaken
for. A bowl of food and a hillside in October are present-day things that
photograph, so a photographic picture of one asserts nothing false.
The text rule does NOT relax, and this is the pack it was written for. An
invented battle is an illustration; an invented Barolo label is a forgery
-- a label is a legal instrument naming a producer and a protected
origin, so a generated one depicts a product that does not exist wearing
a controlled designation. No badge fixes that. Bottles are shot

blurb.no: Ingen land dyrker så mange druesorter. Vi begynner nordvest, i tåka, med en drue som nekter å modne noe annet sted.
blurb.en: No country grows so many grape varieties. We start in the north-west, in the fog, with a grape that refuses to ripen anywhere else.
